name: AR_BR_TRX_BATCH_RPT
description: AR_BR_TRX_BATCH_RPT table contains data populated by the Create Automatic Bills Receivable Batch process. Oracle Fusion Receivables uses this data as the source for the Automatic Bills Receivable Batch report.

columns.name: AR_BR_TRX_BATCH_RPT_KEY
columns.description: Key to identify the bills receivable batch report record.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: BATCH_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the bill receivable batch that contains the bill receivable.

columns.name: BR_CUSTOMER_TRX_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the bill receivable.

columns.name: BILL_NUMBER
columns.description: Number that identifies a bill receivable.

columns.name: BR_AMOUNT
columns.description: Total amount of the bill receivable.

columns.name: BR_CURRENCY
columns.description: The currency of a bill receivable.

columns.name: BATCH_STATUS
columns.description: Status of the bills receivable when the row was created.

columns.name: MATURITY_DATE
columns.description: Date on which a bill receivable is due to be paid.

columns.name: DRAWEE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the drawee on the bill receivable.

columns.name: DRAWEE_CONTACT_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the contact for the bill receivable drawee.

columns.name: DRAWEE_SITE_USE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the drawee site use on a bill receivable.

columns.name: DRAWEE_BANK_ACCOUNT_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the drawee bank account to be used for paying a bill receivable.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the applied transaction.

columns.name: AMOUNT_ASSIGNED
columns.description: Amount of the bill receivable applied to a transaction.

columns.name: RECEIPT_METHOD_NAME
columns.description: Name of the receipt method used to create the automatic bills receivable batch.

columns.name: RECEIPT_CREATION_RULE_CODE
columns.description:
Receipt method grouping rule used to
automatically group transactions into bills receivable.

columns.name: BR_MIN_ACCTD_AMOUNT
columns.description: Minimum accounted amount of the bill receivable.

columns.name: BR_MAX_ACCTD_AMOUNT
columns.description: Maximum accounted amount of the bill receivable.

columns.name: LEAD_DAYS
columns.description: Receipt method value that defines the number of days before the transaction due date that a transaction can be selected for automatic bills receivable batch creation.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
